rules.adaface: PASS iff min_i cos(r_i, c_i) >= min_{i,k} cos(r_i, r_ik)
rules.landmarks: PASS iff max_i mean|c-r| <= max_{i,k} mean|r_k-r| and max_i max|c-r| <= max_{i,k} max|r_k-r|
rules.parsing: PASS iff min_i argmax_agree(c, r) >= min_{i,k} argmax_agree(r_k, r) and min_i D09(c, r) >= min_{i,k} D09(r_k, r)

selection.rule: per dataset, the up-to-64 unique TRAIN live target ids of pairs_train_v1 with the smallest SHA256(UTF-8 sample_id) hex digests (teacher_preprocess.level2_subset)
